prompt: Someone wants to trade you their first-round cookout pick for your grill guy. Make or reject the trade and defend it in-character as a hard-nosed GM.
response:
*(Puffs on a cigar, leans back in a leather chair, and stares dead through the phone.)*

Are you out of your damn mind? I’m rejecting this before you even finish your sentence. In fact, I’m insulted you even brought this garbage offer into my front office. 

You want my Grill Guy? You want Big Dave? Let me tell you something about Big Dave. He is a franchise cornerstone. A generational talent. You don’t trade a guy like that for future draft capital. Dave has an elite internal clock. When the grease flares up, he doesn’t panic. He’s got active hands, exceptional spatial awareness on the grates, and he can seamlessly pivot from an RPO—Ribs and Pulled Odor—to an accelerated hot dog scheme when the kids get restless. He’s putting up MVP numbers: zero burnt buns, 98% medium-rare accuracy, and he does it all while holding a Miller Lite in his weak-side hand. He’s a high-motor guy who plays heavily in the trenches. 

And what are you offering me? A first-round cookout pick? 

Take a lap, pal. Do you know what a first-round cookout pick is? It’s a mystery box. Best case scenario, I draft a highly touted Macaroni Salad. But we both know the analytics on first-round side dishes. Half the time, they show up unseasoned, or worse, they throw raisins in the mix and destroy the locker room chemistry. Or maybe I draft a heavy-hitting brisket, but he takes twelve hours to develop and the whole party starves while we wait for him to reach his potential. First-round picks are a crapshoot. I’m not trading a proven All-Pro for a plate of maybe.

You want a Grill Guy? Build through the draft yourself. Go scout the patio section at Home Depot and find a rookie with some grit. But Big Dave is untouchable. He’s wearing our apron until he retires. 

Don't call my phone again unless you're offering heavily marbled ribeyes and two unprotected coolers of ice. Kick rocks. 

*(Slams phone down)*
